doc: Seconds of each voiced quest line (the processed Ogg in assets/audio/voice). Quest line timing (quest_rules.json: line_type_cps, line_hold_s, line_max_s) shows a line for 2.2-9 s while the voice runs 4-20 s, so a voiced line outlives its subtitle. STATUS temp: these are placeholder voices (the PoF voice room replaces them, human-gated); the quest lane should take max(text time, voice_s + a beat) from here. Written by tools/audio/voice_lengths.py.
